description: Replaces a track's blocking rules with this list (call get_rules first to keep the ones it has). Each rule is {block: "if"|"unless", match: "all"|"any", action: "inbox"|"drop", conditions: [{field, op, value}]}; field is a column key or "@sender". Values compare as written in the sheet, sign included. read_guide page rules has the operators for each type.

rules.description: The whole list, 0 to 20 rules. An empty list removes them all.

action.description: inbox (the default) keeps the message in the Inbox with the reason; drop only counts it.

name: set_rules
title: Set a track's blocking rules
